profiles.name: Modern Standard Arabic
profiles.register_boundary: Learned/formal written register; home vernacular not silently equated with MSA reading proficiency.

preschool.disposition: Oral-to-written, play and early-science caregiver course; Egypt/Morocco separate.

foundational.disposition: Reading comprehension and numeracy underpin science; no Grade4rate multiplied across all primary ages.

secondary.disposition: Complete interrupted-learning science routes especially Yemen/Syria; separate national curriculum mapping.

vocational_practical.disposition: Technical reading,measurement,records,digital/data skills; no quantified labour effect.

university.disposition: Scientific reading and first-year quantitative/computing preparation retained; territory-medium denominators unknown.

research.disposition: Reproducible data/methods materials retained; exact MSA research demand unknown.

packages.title: Accelerated science and reading
packages.full_course_or_edition: Complete bounded upper-primary/lower-secondary sequence: diagnostic,definitions,worked reasoning,practice,answers,print/audio.
packages.smaller_alternative: Index plus printable exercises linked to existing lessons.
packages.provisional_added_value: Continuity for interrupted learners who cannot use a complete existing sequence.
packages.limitations: No examination equivalence; vernacular/MSA learning route and national curriculum must be explicit.

packages.title: Caregiver early-learning course
packages.full_course_or_edition: Sequential stories,observation,number-play and oral-to-written activities; distinct Egypt/Morocco oral supports.
packages.smaller_alternative: Focused caregiver activity/story pack alongside preschool route.
packages.provisional_added_value: Usable home/centre sequence rather than a list of activities.
packages.limitations: Not autonomous preschool self-study or replacement for buildings/staff; no language-matched participation count.

packages.title: Practical data and reproducible analysis
packages.full_course_or_edition: Full spreadsheet,statistics,records and projects course with optional advanced extension and offline files.
packages.smaller_alternative: File-based exercises and feedback around Edraak.
packages.provisional_added_value: Offline independent instruction or a distinct prerequisite/project sequence.
packages.limitations: Free MOOCs already exist; subtitles are not necessarily Arabic spoken instruction; effects/costs unknown.

profiles.name: Iranian Persian
profiles.register_boundary: Iranian written Persian and curriculum/audio conventions; not automatically Dari.

preschool.disposition: Caregiver oral-language and early-science candidate; denominator unknown.

foundational.disposition: Continuity and scientific reading candidate; official full science books exist.

secondary.disposition: Interrupted-school support and computational preparation; no Persian-matched need count.

vocational_practical.disposition: ICT/upskilling rationale documented qualitatively; not measured job-demand count.

university.disposition: Full introductory computing/data and scientific-study course retained; need unknown.

research.disposition: Reproducible technical reports/methods retained; no quantified research readership.

packages.title: Interruption-ready science
packages.full_course_or_edition: One complete science band with scientific reading,observation,measurement,worked explanations and self-check.
packages.smaller_alternative: Annotated official-book route plus diagnostics and answers.
packages.provisional_added_value: Autonomous instruction and continuity, not reproduction of an already complete school book.
packages.limitations: Current Roshd edition/answer coverage not inspected; disruption figure dated5March2026.

packages.title: Computing and data foundations
packages.full_course_or_edition: Full file-management,algorithms,Python,tables and statistics course with offline tests.
packages.smaller_alternative: Offline/prerequisite layer around existing free programming course.
packages.provisional_added_value: Distinct data/statistics sequence or usable offline delivery.
packages.limitations: Provider-indexed course exists; failed fetch is not scarcity; no labour-market effect inferred.

packages.title: Technical study and research bridge
packages.full_course_or_edition: Complete first-year practical course in units,graphs,experimental records,scientific reading and reproducible reports.
packages.provisional_added_value: Support independent study beyond a phrase list.
packages.limitations: Exact matching tertiary provision not exhaustively audited; not lab access or accreditation.

profiles.name: Kurmanji
profiles.register_boundary: Keep Latin-script course and explicitly Badini-provenance KRI Arabic-script route separate. Operational labels, not census allocation.

preschool.disposition: Caregiver picture/audio science and early-literacy component; not unsupervised learning.

foundational.disposition: Script and home/local variety distinguished; subject prerequisites retained.

secondary.disposition: Direct setting-specific Arabic-to-local-Kurdish science transition evidence; no quantified translation effect.

vocational_practical.disposition: Full digital/records/science course retained for specified written route.

packages.title: Local-variety science transition
packages.full_course_or_edition: Complete exact-variety/script destination course for the documented Arabic-to-Kurdish school switch.
packages.smaller_alternative: Glossary and worked practice linked to Badini eWane and language classes.
packages.provisional_added_value: Bridge instructional-language and subject gaps together.
packages.limitations: Do not assign every displaced child to Badini or Latin Kurmanji; counts shared with Sorani.

packages.title: Latin-Kurmanji science and digital skills
packages.full_course_or_edition: Full autonomous general-science/digital-skills course with foundational reading support.
packages.smaller_alternative: Scientific-reading companion for already supported bilingual learners.
packages.provisional_added_value: Usable complete edition in an explicitly selected written route.
packages.limitations: Other Kurmanji science books not ruled out; MEB elective language books are not all-subject provision; Turkish/Arabic alternatives depend on actual usable proficiency.

packages.title: Early-learning sequence and advanced methods bridge
packages.full_course_or_edition: Two separate entry components: caregiver early-learning sequence; complete introductory advanced methods course.
packages.smaller_alternative: Caregiver activity pack or advanced terminology/problem companion, respectively.
packages.provisional_added_value: Retain early and advanced routes without treating one supplement as sufficient for all.
packages.limitations: Two components, not one age-neutral book; readership/intelligibility/effects unknown.
